Results.ReviewText:
I have used Weber for over 55 years, no other grills compare. For younger people, this is an ideal entry grill, for us it is an exit grill. 

It is well made, plenty of grilling space. With the burner reconfiguration from top to bottom rather than left to right, indirect cooking is great. I could control temps using one burner to 250 degrees. Steaks turned out well, same with pork chops. 

It is small and compact and fits well on the patio. Moving it around is a challenge at times. I would recommend the Weber cover. I am trying to decide on the iGrill 2 or 3. I also grill with the deluxe kettle so maybe it is the 2.  A little pricey, but with a 10 year warranty, it is worth every penny.

Thank you for your feedback regarding the Spirit II E-210. We are so sorry to learn your experience did not match your expectations. We are happy to help. 

We want to know a little more information about the front of the grill cooking cooler. 

With regards to food sticking, we have the following recommendations:
 
1. You can oil the food directly, but we do not recommend applying any kind of oil directly to the grates. You can use our Weber Grill Spray, as that is not oil-based.
2. Make sure you're giving your food enough time per side. Food will naturally start to rise off the grates when close to flipping time.
3. If using a marinade, try to get as much excess liquid off as possible before placing the food on the grill.
4. If using a sauce of any kind, wait until the last 5 minutes or so to apply.
5. We recommend cleaning your cooking grates every time you use your grill. Simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes with the lid closed and then brush the grates clean with a Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush.

Please look for an outreach email from our Support team. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Overpriced grill that lacks quality material. I've owned this for a year now and have cooked throughout the seasons. This cooks well enough, and seems to keep a decently even temperature in the middle and rear. Though the front tends to cook cooler. My issues are with the quality of the exterior. The stainless components are an incredibly cheap form of "stainless." Unless you clean after each use with recommended cleaner and microfiber cloth it will stain and discolor. Which seems ridiculous for an outside grill. Which I also keep covered. There is much better quality stainless material available and for the price, this grill shouldn't be that delicate. The painted lid isn't much better. The "porcelain-enameled" cast iron grates are "meh," they require just as much upkeep and care as regular cast iron. My issue is with how thick the grates are, it just increases the surface area that is going to stick to your food. If they were about half the thickness they would probably be better. Overall, I expected better quality and less delicacy for the price and from Weber, though it does cook decently. For the next question on the form, "would you recommend this product to a friend?" Yes, but only if you buy it heavily discounted, it certainly isn't "quality" for the full MSRP.
Results.Title: Exterior Should be More Rugged for the Price

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
